objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed artifact created, edited, released, distributed, archived, revised, invalidated, reactivated, translated, and displayed in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type selected when creating a new document and used for structuring, templates, validity period, and archive duration.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to differentiate documents for clarity and evaluation.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation of the document; type abbreviations are the same for all languages.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Number assigned to a document and adaptable to requirements.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version metadata that can be printed in the document and is retained or updated through versioning.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Document status used in the status network and workflow.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Document metadata that can be printed using TAG technology.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which document validity is calculated.

attributes.name: valid_until_date
attributes.description: Date calculated from the valid from date and period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which extended validity must be checked for each document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained for each document type.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Distribution attribute affecting e-mail notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Distribution attribute affecting workflow task distribution when the next version is released.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type for locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details, and responsible persons.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed work steps relevant for a few departments.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating new objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or documents generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File or document uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: Object attached to create new documents, additional information, attachments, and requests.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data such as IT applications that documents can be automatically linked with.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process that can be automatically linked with documents.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit that can be automatically linked with documents.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk that can be automatically linked with documents.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example referenced in document properties.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Relevant company maintained in document properties.

objs.name: area_of_validity
objs.description: Area of validity maintained in document properties.

objs.name: reference
objs.description: Reference maintained in document properties or created to another document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Person using DHC VISION who may act as creator, author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, initiator, or workflow participant.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for role assignment, reader authorization, distribution, archive access, and business administration.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: User role that can view approved objects and take note of documents.

objs.name: author
objs.description: User role assigned to documents with read and write permissions and responsible for signing document creation in the workflow.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: User role assigned to documents with personal change rights and no relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: User role that checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: User role responsible for the document and its content and deciding whether it is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: User role that can translate released content into another language.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: User group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read and change right assigned to user groups or persons for each document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to distribution for a document.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary object added to a document, released and published directly via properties switches, and not subject to the main document release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document and automatically released with the main document.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for a document without affecting document content or version history and managed in the document cockpit.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document 30 days before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a selected released document and processed by workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created for revalidating invalidated documents and processed by workflow.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants for release, acknowledgement, validity extension, AKS, or reactivation processing.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to users about workflow tasks, status, change proposals, validity extension, AKS, release, acknowledgement, and distribution.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by a recipient that they have taken note of a released document version.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific display listing relevant documents and document-dependent details.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation or search output for documents, instructions, acknowledgements, or workflow status.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document can be specified as visible or not visible.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a released document visible to authorized readers in the corresponding login language after release.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one of the templates defined for the document type when creating a new object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for later upload or generation of documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate a new document based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific metadata in document properties.

evts.name: maintain_authorization_assignment
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit document content using the editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: print_metadata_in_document
evts.description: Automatically print document metadata in the document using integrated TAG technology.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert the saved document to PDF and display the current version on the web.

evts.name: change_released_document
evts.description: Change content or properties of a released document, resulting in creation of a new editing version.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new version in editing status when a released document is revised or when attachment changes require it.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add an object of type Additional Info to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish additional information directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly due to its lack of criticality.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an Attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an Attachment for archiving and archive it with release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: delete_edited_attachment
evts.description: Delete Attachments that are no longer relevant to a new version before release.

evts.name: assign_reader
evts.description: Assign reader authorization via a user group assignment in the Reader attribute.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Assign an author to a document, with the creator automatically confirmed by default in the Author field.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Assign additional personal change rights via the Co-authors attribute.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Assign reviewers maintained in document attributes for review.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Assign releasers maintained in document attributes for release.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Initiate the 3-step release process after document creation, attribute maintenance, content maintenance, and document control definition.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the creation of the document in the first workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks the document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser releases the document after review, causing publication and visibility to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_workflow_task
evts.description: Reject a review or release task, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants immediately after the first rejection.

evts.name: send_e_mail_notification
evts.description: Inform users by e-mail about workflow status, tasks, proposals, validity extension, AKS, releases, and acknowledgements.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task_with_signature
evts.description: Workflow participant completes a task with an electronic signature.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Document signatures of individual participants in the system for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a Change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Create a request for validity extension 30 days before the valid until date.

evts.name: process_validity_extension_by_releaser
evts.description: Releaser currently entered on the document checks and processes the validity extension.

evts.name: process_validity_extension_by_release_participants
evts.description: Author, co-authors, reviewers, and releaser process extended validity with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity and update the valid until date while deleting the validity extension request.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create a new version by the author and update the document when it needs revision.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process and delete the request when a revised version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document to invalidate it.

evts.name: process_aks_by_releaser
evts.description: Releaser currently entered on the document carries out AKS.

evts.name: process_aks_by_applicant_reviewer_releaser
evts.description: Creator of the request, reviewers, and releasers process AKS in three steps.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declare document and attachments invalid and archive them by revoking authorizations except archive group access.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Delete existing edited versions after declaration of Out of force.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the provided folder and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the workflow for a request for reactivation.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of the request confirms reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Create a new version of an invalidated document and restore metadata, properties, authorizations, distribution list, and attachments.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivate attachments archived with the document during reactivation.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain user groups and persons on the distribution list for the document.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request persons and users of assigned user groups to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient actively confirms acknowledgement of a released document version without signature.

evts.name: notify_acknowledgement_completion
evts.description: Notify the author team as soon as all persons maintained in the Distribution have confirmed acknowledgement.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards based on distribution groups in the distribution list per document.

evts.name: display_document_list
evts.description: List all documents relevant to the user in the Document list dashboard.

evts.name: display_document_details
evts.description: Display detailed information such as attachments, additional information, referenced documents, and language versions when a document is selected.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Evaluate documents, instructions, acknowledgements, or workflow status depending on selected parameters.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content and documents into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check the translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release the translated version so it is visible to authorized readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: assign_translation_participants
evts.description: Assign participants for checking and releasing translation in the document properties dialog.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not visible.

evts.name: create_local_document_addition
evts.description: Create a new document in a client to describe a local change or extension and reference the original document.

o2o.description: Policy is a document type used for company-wide regulations.
Guideline is a document type used for locally defined or business-process-related regulations.
Procedural Instruction is a document type describing specific procedures and process sequences.
Work Instruction is a document type documenting detailed work steps.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type and selected when creating documents.
External files or documents can be uploaded to a pure object cover for a document.
External files or documents can be uploaded to an object cover.
New documents are created by attachment of a new information object.
Documents can be automatically linked with master data.
Documents can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents can be automatically linked with risks.
IT applications can be maintained as references in document properties.
Relevant companies can be maintained via document properties.
Areas of validity can be maintained via document properties.
References can be maintained via document properties or created to original documents.
Documents can be linked with other documents or referenced by local additions.
Users can be assigned to a document in roles or distribution.
User groups can be assigned to documents for reader authorization, role selection, and distribution.
Users assigned to user groups are offered in selection lists or receive permissions and notifications.
A user can act as reader.
A user can act as author.
A user can act as co-author.
A user can act as reviewer.
A user can act as releaser.
A user can act as translator.
Archive group is a specific user group with read access to archived documents.
Business Admin group is a user group permitted to create reactivation requests.
Authorizations are assigned specifically to documents.
Personal authorizations are assigned to users for author, co-author, reviewer, and releaser roles.
Reader authorizations and group rights are assigned through user groups.
Distribution list is maintained per document.
Persons can be assigned to the distribution list.
User groups can be assigned to the distribution list.
Additional information can be added to each document.
Attachments can be added to documents and are associated with versions of the main document.
A Change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for AKS is created for a selected document.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding document for reactivation.
Workflow tasks are assigned to users involved in workflows.
Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature.
Signatures are documented for each released version and can be printed as document content.
Users receive e-mail notifications.
E-mail notifications can relate to documents and document versions.
Acknowledgements are documented for documents and summarized for authors or key roles.
Users can confirm acknowledgement of documents.
Dashboards list relevant documents and document-dependent details.
Reports provide evaluations of documents stored in the system.
A report lists acknowledgements depending on status.
For each document, client visibility can be specified.
A translated language version belongs to a document.
Authorized readers see the released language version in the corresponding login language.

Users of assigned user groups are informed by e-mail.
